thread: If you want a Supabase alternative because you'd like to own your database, the answer is a managed PostgreSQL you control, since Supabase runs on standard Postgres.
Two honest paths get you there.
Migrate your data to a managed PostgreSQL with `pg_dump` and `psql`, then repoint `DATABASE_URL`.
Or run self-hosted Supabase itself as a one-click app on a server you own.
